properties.caveats: Hand-built point; no USACE GIS service exists. USACE legacy Water Control site (mvp-wc.usace.army.mil) carries a banner that it will be retired in fall 2026 with a replacement under development — re-check the gauge link-out at publish time; the three gauge URLs returned HTTP 200 on 2026-11-21. Interpretive wording needs tribal guidance: the dams flooded Ojibwe land; 1985 settlement $3,390,288 for land taken (Carroll, Minnesota History, Spring 1990, MNHS). No interpretive text is included in this file — factual fields only.
properties.control_structure_note: Present 294-ft control structure: reinforced concrete abutments and piers supported by timber pilings, with slide gates in five of the 25 6-ft sluiceways and one 12-ft log sluice
properties.coordinate_source: GNIS Dam-class entry / USGS 1:24K topographic map, Federal Dam, MN quad (NAD83/WGS84); corroborated by National Inventory of Dams MN00585 (47.24833, -94.22167)
properties.dam_tenders_house: Built 1902-1904; moved off-site, no longer on site
properties.headwaters_dam_number: second dam built in the Headwaters reservoir system
properties.location_note: On the Leech Lake River at the outlet of Leech Lake, 27 miles above the junction of the Leech Lake River and the Mississippi River; riverbanks about 3,500 ft apart at the dam site, the largest span in the system
properties.name: Leech Lake Dam
properties.operator: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, St. Paul District
properties.rebuilt_note: Timber dam replaced with reinforced concrete, 1900-1903
properties.usace_gauge_location_note: USACE gauge station MissHW_Leech is at the dam, approx. 47.24747, -94.22184 (USACE-sourced) — about 90 m south of the GNIS dam-structure point; the point in this file marks the dam structure, the gauge URLs are the live link-out
properties.usgs_discontinued_gauges: 05206000 Leech Lake at Federal Dam (LK) and 05206500 Leech Lake River at Federal Dam (ST) are discontinued; dam outflow is USACE-only
